title: ROV, camera and lights fail at the object

tellings.quote: >> Yep. And when we have dive on it, the camera stops working, the light stops working.

plain: In 2011, when a team dove on a strange object lying on the floor of the Baltic Sea, their equipment failed: the remote-controlled underwater vehicle, its camera and its lights all stopped working. Dennis Asberg, the treasure hunter whose team found the object, says this happened while he was there: "the camera stops working, the light stops working."
